description: Exploration planner CMake configure failed: bundled FindOpenVDB.cmake calls find_package(Blosc REQUIRED) but the package's CMakeModules shipped no FindBlosc.cmake
ruining_rationale: CMake configure fails before any node can run; necessarily caught at build time.

description: docker-compose: merge-conflict markers left in robot/docker/docker-compose.yaml by merge ae3f4550 (pull from demo); file unparsable by docker compose
evidence_quote: repair docker compose | removed lines: "<<<<<<< HEAD", "=======", ">>>>>>> 2d5142109ef4a1887895a954e2111da3ba147e75"
ruining_rationale: docker compose refuses to parse the file, so no container starts; visible immediately at bring-up.

description: CMakeLists declared find_package(vdb_mapping REQUIRED) and linked vdb_mapping::vdb_mapping although no source used it; unresolvable after merge, build failed (exploration; later inspection_planning)
evidence_quote: fix cmakelist after merge | "-find_package(vdb_mapping REQUIRED)" -> "+# find_package(vdb_mapping REQUIRED)"
ruining_rationale: colcon build fails at configure time; cannot reach a running experiment.

description: docker-compose: merge 0c467a58 dropped 'tmux new -d -s robot_bringup'; autolaunch send-keys targeted a nonexistent session; bridge network and ssh ports replaced by network_mode: host
evidence_quote: fixed docker compoer env | "+        tmux new -d -s robot_bringup;" ; "-    network_mode: host"
ruining_rationale: Autolaunch silently does nothing at container start (tmux: no server running); visible before any experiment begins.

description: docker-compose: unterminated single quote in tmux send-keys command ('bws && sws;) introduced four minutes earlier by 54a1f7e4; container command string malformed
evidence_quote: another fix | "-        tmux send-keys -t robot_bringup 'bws && sws;" -> "+        tmux send-keys -t robot_bringup 'bws && sws' ENTER;"
ruining_rationale: Malformed shell command fails at container start; fixed within four minutes of introduction.

description: waypoint_routing_node declares sub_target_path_topic with no default; exploration_config.yaml lacked the key, so initialize() logged 'Cannot read parameter' and returned before creating any subscription
ruining_rationale: Node starts but never subscribes or plans; the failure surfaces only when exploration is toggled and nothing happens.

description: Waypoint routing never popped the reached waypoint from target_path, so after arrival (or stall) it re-planned to the same first waypoint indefinitely
ruining_rationale: Deterministic: the vehicle reaches waypoint 1 and loops on it, stalling any multi-waypoint route mid-run.

description: filter_predicted_semantics in-FOV test rejected points with camera-frame z<=0 while the same function treats +x as the optical axis; semantic points misclassified as behind camera
ruining_rationale: Wrong FOV culling degrades inspection-target filtering; no flight-safety path involved.
fix_loc: 119+/69- (whole file; commit also rewrites frustum visualization)

description: VDBUtil::createCoordBBox rounded bbox corners to nearest cell center, silently dropping the outermost voxel layer from collision-check boxes; replaced with floor/ceil on a continuous index bbox
evidence_quote: If bbox_max lands just past a cell center, rounding can pull it back and you’ll silently drop the outermost layer of cells.
ruining_rationale: Collision checks used a thinner box than configured; whether this produced a collision in a run is not recorded.
fix_loc: 58+/26- (whole file; commit also adds RRT shortening)

description: pid_path_tracker odometry subscription used reliable QoS depth 1, incompatible with a best-effort odometry publisher; changed to SensorDataQoS (cmd_vel variant here, cmd_vel_stamped variant in dd521a90)
ruining_rationale: A best-effort publisher never matches a reliable subscriber, so the tracker holds with no commands from the first second; likely noticed at session start.
fix_loc: 1+/1- per file (whole commits: 3431e263 133+/13- in that file; dd521a90 156+/23- in that file; both fix multiple listed defects)

description: Command and planning timers created with create_wall_timer ignored /clock under use_sim_time; replaced by rclcpp::create_timer on the node clock in pid_path_tracker_cmd_vel, _cmd_vel_stamped and cpa_node
ruining_rationale: Wall-clock timers run at wall rate while the rest of the stack follows sim time; effect on a run depends on real-time factor.
fix_loc: 7+/2- ; 156+/23- ; 13+/8- (whole files; commit fixes multiple listed defects)

description: Astar::initialize hard-coded safe_robot_r_=0.5 and ran before setup_parameters(), so the node's safe_robot_r parameter never reached A* clearance; now passed in after parameters are read
ruining_rationale: A* planned with 0.5 m clearance while the node's collision checker used the configured radius (0.8 in integrated_node); paths could be planned and immediately flagged as colliding.
fix_loc: 2+/2- (astar_vdb.cpp) ; 1+/1- (astar_vdb.hpp) ; call-site lines in cpa_node.cpp and integrated_node.cpp (whole commit 286+/80-; fixes multiple listed defects)

description: After collision replan, dense path start snapped to the A* voxel center, dragging the commanded start off the tracked pose; precise start pose now restored
evidence_quote: +            // To avoid voxel plan drag the start point back to cell center
ruining_rationale: Produces a step in the commanded trajectory at every replan; magnitude bounded by half a voxel (0.1-0.2 m).
fix_loc: 90+/34- (whole file in commit; fixes multiple listed defects)

description: Lidar odometry bridge reused mocap rigid-body extrinsics and topic; replaced with SuperOdom tilted-lidar transform chain, /laser_odometry input, frame_id rewrite node, map->superodom_map static TF
ruining_rationale: The bridge feeds /fmu/in/vehicle_visual_odometry; a wrong-frame pose fused by PX4 EKF2 on the ModalAI vehicle corrupts the in-flight state estimate.

description: lidar_modal_ai.launch still remapped pid_path_tracker_px4 odometry to /mocap_odom_processed although the lidar bridge had published /lidar_odom_processed since f1f65593; tracker received no odometry
ruining_rationale: Tracker publishes no commands without odometry; surfaces at the start of a hardware session rather than mid-flight.
fix_loc: 11+/9- (whole file; commit fixes multiple listed defects)

description: VehicleOdometry to PX4 stamped with ROS epoch microseconds instead of PX4 HRT; timestamps now 0 so uXRCE-DDS client stamps on receive (publisher QoS also best_effort)
evidence_quote: +        // Leave timestamps at 0: uXRCE-DDS client stamps with PX4 HRT on receive
ruining_rationale: EKF2 rejects external-vision samples whose timestamps fall outside its time base, so fusion silently does not occur; effect depends on whether EKF2 was relying on it.
